license_required.quote: Unless licensed pursuant to the Optometry Act, or specifically exempted or excluded from the application of all or part of that act, a person shall not: A. practice optometry

name.quote: There is created a six-member "board of optometry"

type.quote: There is created a six-member "board of optometry"

umbrella_agency.quote: The board shall be administratively attached to the regulation and licensing department.

age_minimum.quote: has reached the age of majority

degree_required.quote: has graduated and been awarded a doctor of optometry degree from a school or college of optometry approved and accredited by the board

accrediting_body.quote: a school or college of optometry approved and accredited by the board

exams.name: Optometry Licensure Examination
exams.notes: Written tests, practical demonstrations, and may include oral tests; confined to subjects within curriculum of approved colleges of optometry
exams.quote: The examination shall be confined to the subjects within the curriculum of colleges of optometry approved and accredited by the board and shall include written tests and practical demonstrations and may include oral tests.

exams.name: Pharmaceutical Agents Examination
exams.notes: Required prior to licensure for certification in use of pharmaceutical agents
exams.quote: Applicants for licensure shall meet the requirements for certification in the use of pharmaceutical agents as set forth in the Optometry Act and shall successfully complete the board's examination in pharmaceutical agents prior to licensure.

interval_years.quote: A license shall be renewed annually on or before July 1.

required.quote: has completed, as a condition of licensure by endorsement, the continuing education requirements as set by the rules of the board

available.quote: No later than thirty days after an out-of-state licensee files an application for an expedited license, the board shall process the application and issue an expedited license in accordance with Section 61-1-31.1 NMSA 1978.

requirements.value: Expedited licensure available for out-of-state licensees; board determines by rule which states/territories are approved or disapproved; if prior jurisdiction did not require examination, board may require passage of exam before renewal.
requirements.quote: The board by rule shall determine those states and territories of the United States and the District of Columbia from which it will not accept an applicant for expedited licensure and shall determine any foreign countries from which it will accept an applicant for expedited licensure.

regulatory_model.quote: Unless licensed pursuant to the Optometry Act, or specifically exempted or excluded from the application of all or part of that act, a person shall not: A. practice optometry

credential_type.quote: Each applicant for a license to practice optometry as provided in Chapter 61, Article 2 NMSA 1978 who successfully passes the examination for licensure, possesses the required educational qualifications and meets other requirements of the Optometry Act or regulations adopted pursuant to that act is entitled to a license that carries with it the title "doctor of optometry".

is_mandatory.quote: practicing or attempting to practice optometry without a valid current license issued by the board

title_protection.quote: selling or using any designation, diploma or certificate tending to imply that one is a practitioner of optometry, unless one holds a license as provided by the Optometry Act

scope_protection.quote: Unless licensed pursuant to the Optometry Act, or specifically exempted or excluded from the application of all or part of that act, a person shall not: A. practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony, as shown by a certified copy of the record of the court of conviction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continued practice by a person knowingly having an infectious or contagious disease
disciplinary_grounds.quote: continued practice by a person knowingly having an infectious or contagious disease

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising by means of knowingly false, misleading or deceptive statements or practicing under a name other than one's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: advertising by means of knowingly false, misleading or deceptive statements or advertising or attempting to practice under a name other than one's own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual drunkenness or addiction to habit-forming drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: habitual drunkenness or addiction to the use of habit-forming drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not duly licensed
disciplinary_grounds.quote: aiding or abetting in the practice of optometry any person not duly licensed to practice optometry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Lending, leasing or placing one's certificate of license at the disposal of any unlicensed person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: lending, leasing or in any other manner placing his certificate of license at the disposal or in the service of any person not licensed to practice optometry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing, procuring or inducing an unlicensed person to practice optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: employing, procuring or inducing an unlicensed person to practice optometry in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating any provision of the Optometry Act
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating any of the provisions of the Optometry Act

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any act defined as unprofessional conduct by board regulation, including fraud, fee splitting, and improper advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: committing any act defined as "unprofessional conduct" by regulation of the board filed in accordance with the State Rules Act

definition_quote.value: the employment of any subjective or objective means or methods, including but not limited to the use of lenses, prisms, autorefractors or other automated testing devices, and includes the prescription or administration of drugs for the purpose of diagnosing the visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa; (2) the employing, adapting or prescribing of preventive or corrective measures, including but not limited to lenses, prisms, contact or corneal lenses or other optical appliances, ocular exercises, vision therapy, vision training and vision rehabilitation services, and includes the prescription or administration of all drugs rational for the correction, relief or referral of visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa
definition_quote.quote: the employment of any subjective or objective means or methods, including but not limited to the use of lenses, prisms, autorefractors or other automated testing devices, and includes the prescription or administration of drugs for the purpose of diagnosing the visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa

value: use of lenses, prisms, autorefractors or other automated testing devices
preventive or corrective measures including contact or corneal lenses
ocular exercises, vision therapy, vision training and vision rehabilitation services
in-office minor surgical procedures (non-laser eyelid lesion removal, foreign body removal, corneal debridement, eyelash removal, tear drainage structure procedures)
methods_authorized.quote: the employing, adapting or prescribing of preventive or corrective measures, including but not limited to lenses, prisms, contact or corneal lenses or other optical appliances, ocular exercises, vision therapy, vision training and vision rehabilitation services, and includes the prescription or administration of all drugs rational for the correction, relief or referral of visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye and its adnexa

drug_authority.value: Optometrists certified by the board may prescribe or administer all pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of disease of the eye or adnexa; may prescribe hydrocodone and hydrocodone combination medications; may administer epinephrine auto-injections to counter anaphylaxis; shall not prescribe any other controlled substance classified in Schedule I or II.
drug_authority.quote: optometrists qualified and certified by the board may prescribe or administer all pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of disease of the eye or adnexa

surgery_prohibited.quote: does not include the use of surgery or injections in the treatment of eye diseases except for the use of the following types of in-office minor surgical procedures

surgery_definition.value: Surgery is generally excluded from optometric practice except for specified in-office minor surgical procedures including non-laser removal/destruction/drainage of superficial eyelid lesions and conjunctival cysts, removal of nonperforating foreign bodies, non-laser corneal debridement/culture/scrape/anterior puncture, removal of eyelashes, and probing/dilation/irrigation/closure of tear drainage structures.
surgery_definition.quote: does not include the use of surgery or injections in the treatment of eye diseases except for the use of the following types of in-office minor surgical procedures

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: removal of nonperforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva and eyelid

value: non-laser removal, destruction or drainage of superficial eyelid lesions and conjunctival cysts
removal of nonperforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva and eyelid
non-laser corneal debridement, culture, scrape or anterior puncture (not including removal of pterygium, corneal biopsy or removal of corneal neoplasias)
probing, dilation, irrigation or closure of the tear drainage structures of the eyelid; scalpel use only on skin surrounding the eye
minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: non-laser removal, destruction or drainage of superficial eyelid lesions and conjunctival cysts; (b) removal of nonperforating foreign bodies from the cornea, conjunctiva and eyelid; (c) non-laser corneal debridement, culture, scrape or anterior puncture, not including removal of pterygium, corneal biopsy or removal of corneal neoplasias; (d) removal of eyelashes; and (e) probing, dilation, irrigation or closure of the tear drainage structures of the eyelid

anaphylaxis_treatment_authorized.quote: may administer epinephrine auto-injections to counter anaphylaxis

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: ocular exercises, vision therapy, vision training and vision rehabilitation services

value: Schedule II controlled substances prohibited (except hydrocodone and hydrocodone combination medications are permitted)
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: shall not prescribe any other controlled substance classified in Schedule I or II pursuant to the Controlled Substances Act

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: optometrists qualified and certified by the board may prescribe or administer all pharmaceutical agents for the diagnosis and treatment of disease of the eye or adnexa

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: develop and administer qualifications for certification for the use of pharmaceutical agents as authorized in Section 61-2-10.2 NMSA 1978, including minimum educational requirements and examination

specialty_certification_types.quote: The board shall issue certification for the use of pharmaceutical agents as set forth in Subsection A of this section to optometrists currently licensed by the board.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The course shall constitute a minimum of twenty hours of instruction in clinical pharmacology, including systemic pharmacology as applied to optometry

telemedicine_authorized.quote: Nothing in this section shall be construed to prohibit: (1) a health care provider from using telehealth in accordance with the provisions of the New Mexico Telehealth Act for ocular diseases

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: indicate a specific date of expiration, which shall be twenty-four months from the date of the prescription, unless, in the professional opinion of the prescriber, a longer or shorter expiration date is in the best interests of the patient

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: refusing, after a request, to provide a patient a copy of the patient's eyeglasses prescription, if the prescription is not over one year old

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The request shall be in writing and signed by the patient, and shall be retained in the patient's file for at least five years.

retired_license_status_available.quote: An optometrist who intends to retire from the practice of optometry shall notify the board in writing before the expiration of the optometrist's license
